packageRules.description: Group patch-level bumps across managers into one PR per week.
Rust: bump manifest constraints; humans regenerate Cargo.lock intentionally.
Python: bump pyproject.toml constraints; uv.lock refresh happens on the same PR (renovate runs `uv lock` post-update).
Docker base images: rate-limit to monthly to avoid churn from daily point releases.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
